name: Upfluence
description: Search and analyze Upfluence's creator intelligence directly in Claude. Search millions of creators across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Twitch, X (Twitter), and Pinterest, resolve any handle or profile URL to a creator, analyze audience demographics by age, gender, country, and city, and surface the brands a creator has worked with or mentioned. With Upfluence as persistent context, Claude can reason about creators and audiences alongside your briefs, campaigns, and decisions, across any conversation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Upfluence to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Upfluence to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.upfluence.co/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Upfluence MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Upfluence provides these MCP tools: fetch_audience_features, fetch_brand_mentions, list_influencers, resolve_influencer_id_from_media_handle, resolve_influencer_id_from_media_url, and search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Upfluence?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Upfluence in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
Upfluence requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Upfluence is developed by Upfluence. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
